the round-2 OPTION channel: a single capitalised or cased-script token (Iker, Светлана, Γιώργος, Okonkwo) is an enumeration the contract vouches for, travels as an option under any label the person-field vocabulary does not name, and vouches for the identical source value as L1
any alphabetic word is an enumeration piece, so a name is an enumeration token whatever the vocabulary says
Georgian Mkhedruli counts as a cased script, so a Georgian name is free text as a value and only its shape rule protects it
the round-3 ISO_CODE rule: LEE, WU, LIM and HO are codes by shape and travel as L1 exemplars and as options under any label the name rule does not know
the compact rule calls every digit-bearing token a code: HENDERSON7, jkowalski1 and mlopez01 are enumeration codes, travel as options and vouch for the identical source value as L1

the name list is not read over the letters beside a digit: zuleika7 and ZULEIKA7 are refused as handles at most, never as the names they carry, and the name reading the compact rule is built on is gone
the forbidden partial repair: digits at or above the letters make a code, so WU99, LI2024 and NDEBELE8 travel as options and vouch for the identical source value
the forbidden partial repair: any two-to-three capitals before a separator and digits are a prefix, so NDE-8, HEN_2024 and KOW-01 travel as options and vouch for the identical source value
a handle among the values is UNKNOWN, not personal: refused by omission, and the audit predicate that a handle must not remain UNKNOWN fails
a handle as a label, api name, memory pattern or repair code is judged by the channel allow-list alone: HENDERSON7 passes the identifier grammar and travels as an api name and a repair code
a digit-bearing option is read piece by piece again: ES-2024 is the ISO code ES beside the integer 2024 and travels as an option
a hump of one letter inside a run is the symbol it spells: nG1, wU99 and yN1 are codes again, travel as options and vouch for the identical source value (review PRIVACY-009-CASE-BYPASS)

a handle longer than 64 characters is outside the compact rule: it falls to the length rule as free text, the column that carries it is not withheld and the Active beside it travels as L1 (review PRIVACY-009-LENGTH-BYPASS)
the metadata length rule is read before the handle rule: a ninety-seven-character handle is free text on OPTION, LABEL and IDENTIFIER (review PRIVACY-009-LENGTH-BYPASS)

a mask token is keyed by the secret and the profile alone: the same masked label is the same reference across agencies, clients, attempts and revisions (re-anchored for masking policy 1.4.0, which added the attempt to the key)
no word is a homonym: Klein, Petit, Price and Campos travel as options beside Zbigniew and García and under Comercial, Vendedor and Created by, and vouch for the identical source value as L1
the list a homonym stands in is not read: Klein and Petit beside Zbigniew under Segmento travel as options and vouch for the identical source value
only the narrow person-field vocabulary restricts a homonym: Klein and Petit under Comercial, Gross and Grand under Vendedor travel as options and vouch for the identical source value
the pre-consolidation acronym shape: SMITH, LEE and PATEL are structural labels in capitals while Smith is a name — capitalisation authorises
the pre-consolidation join grammar: OkonkwoNdebele and Okonkwo_Ndebele are structural labels because they are joined, whatever the pieces are
the pre-consolidation identifier grammar: Okonkwo, OKONKWO and OkonkwoNdebele are identifiers by the pattern alone and travel as api names, object names and sheet names
the vendor suffix admits a whole option: Okonkwo__c is an enumeration token by its suffix and travels as an option

the retained case admission on the IDENTIFIER channel: any lower-case word is an identifier piece, so vaskemar, pelsira and ondriel_vaskemar travel as api names (review PRIVACY-IDENTIFIER-CASE-BYPASS)

the retained constant admission: any upper-case piece of a compound is an identifier piece, so ONDRIEL_VASKEMAR travels as an api name and UNKNOWN_PARAM_TOLVENO as a repair code (review PRIVACY-IDENTIFIER-CASE-BYPASS)
the vocabulary segmentation admits a lower-case word it cannot split into vocabulary words: vaskemar and pelsira are identifiers again
a surname the lists know is split into vocabulary words: rolland is rol and land, and travels as an api name
a value joined by underscores around an unknown piece (ondriel_vaskemar, pelsira__c) is UNKNOWN again: the column fails its task closed and the provider never sees the question
a proper noun joined into a compound (OndrielVaskemar) is text again as a value: where no target lists it, a repair round sends masked shapes of a column of names
a value the target lists as a person is text again: in a repair round the masked shapes of VASKEMAR and vaskemar leave as L2 exemplars of a column of names
a suffixed name in an option list does not make it a list of people: Klein beside Pelsira__c is the word and travels as an option
